description: Sandboxes, turns, latency, tokens and secret stores of an Aviary installation, from its metrics.

panels.title: Pods up
panels.description: Supervisor pods whose metrics endpoint answered the last scrape.

panels.title: Turns
panels.description: Turns that have left the queue and not ended, whether starting, running or awaiting approval, and turns that wait in the queue, now.

panels.title: Accepted turns
panels.description: Messages accepted as turns per minute, of all harnesses.

panels.title: Turn success
panels.description: Completed turns among the turns that completed, failed or expired in the selected range. Cancelled turns are not counted.

panels.title: Failed and expired turns
panels.description: Turns that failed, and turns that expired in the queue, in the selected range.

panels.title: Refused messages
panels.description: Messages that were not accepted as turns in the selected range, because the queue was full or the session was busy.

panels.title: Queue wait p95
panels.description: 95th percentile of the time that turns waited in the queue, over the selected range.

panels.title: Startup p95
panels.description: 95th percentile of the time from a turn leaving the queue until its harness had the message, over the selected range. It includes creating or waking the sandbox.

panels.title: Sandboxes now
panels.description: Sandboxes of the sessions that have not ended, by state, as the state metrics count them in the database.

panels.title: Sandboxes by state
panels.description: Sandboxes of the sessions that have not ended. An awake sandbox runs on a worker, and an asleep one is kept as a snapshot. A lost one is gone although its session has not ended.

panels.title: Turns now
panels.description: Turns that have not ended, by state, as the state metrics count them in the database.

panels.title: Turns by state
panels.description: Turns that have not ended. A turn that has left the queue is starting until its harness has the message, and then running, or awaiting approval while one of its requests waits for a person. All three take room among the turns that may run at once.

panels.title: Oldest turn by state
panels.description: Age of the oldest turn in each state: since its message for a queued turn, and since it left the queue for the others. An age well beyond the limit of its state means that no Supervisor is ending the turn.

panels.title: Accepted turns
panels.description: Turns accepted per minute, of all harnesses: those that started at once, and those that waited in the queue.

panels.title: Ended turns by state
panels.description: Turns that ended per minute, by state.

panels.title: Turns by Supervisor
panels.description: Turns that each Supervisor follows. A turn whose Supervisor stops is taken over by another.

panels.title: Failed turns by reason
panels.description: Turns that failed per minute, by failure reason.

panels.title: Failures by reason
panels.description: Turns that failed in the selected range, by failure reason.

panels.title: Ended turns by harness
panels.description: Turns that ended in the selected range, by harness and state.

panels.title: Refused messages by reason
panels.description: Messages per minute that were not accepted as turns: queue_full when the queue was full, session_busy when the session had an unfinished turn.

panels.title: Queue length when accepted
panels.description: Queued turns, the new one included, when turns were accepted. 0 for a turn that started at once.

panels.title: Approval answers by outcome
panels.description: Approval requests answered per minute, by the kind of the selected option, or cancelled if the turn was stopped first.

panels.title: Approval requests waiting
panels.description: Approval requests that wait for a person's answer. A turn can have several.

panels.title: Queue wait
panels.description: Time that turns waited in the queue, from their message until a Supervisor took them.

panels.title: Startup by harness
panels.description: Time from a turn leaving the queue until its harness had the message, by harness. It includes creating or waking the sandbox.

panels.title: Startup distribution
panels.description: Turns per minute by startup time. Turns that create or wake a sandbox take longer than those whose sandbox is running.

panels.title: Run duration by state
panels.description: Time from a turn's harness having the message until the turn ended, by state.

panels.title: Run duration distribution
panels.description: Turns per minute by run duration.

panels.title: Approval wait by outcome
panels.description: Time from a harness asking for approval until it had the answer, by outcome.

panels.title: Tokens by kind
panels.description: Tokens per minute that the harnesses reported for ended turns, by kind. Harnesses differ in what they count.

panels.title: Tokens by harness
panels.description: Tokens of all kinds per minute that the harnesses reported for ended turns, by harness.

panels.title: Tokens per ended turn
panels.description: Average tokens per turn that ended in the selected range, by kind.

panels.title: Secret reads
panels.description: Values read from the projects' secret stores per second, by store kind and outcome. Values that a Supervisor has cached are not read.

panels.title: Secret read time
panels.description: Time that the secret stores took to return a value, by store kind.

panels.title: Secret reads in range
panels.description: Values read from secret stores in the selected range, and reads that failed. A model request whose key cannot be read gets 503.

panels.title: Supervisor pods
panels.description: The Supervisor pods now: how long they have run, and their CPU, memory, goroutines and open files.

panels.title: Supervisor pods up
panels.description: Whether each Supervisor pod answered its scrapes. Replaced pods end and new pods begin.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: CPU used by each Supervisor, in cores.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Resident memory of each Supervisor, and the part of it that its Go heap uses.

panels.title: Goroutines
panels.description: Goroutines of each Supervisor. They grow with the turns that it follows and the event streams that it serves.

panels.title: Garbage collection
panels.description: Garbage collections per minute of each Supervisor, and the longest of its recent stop-the-world pauses (dashed, right axis).

panels.title: Open files
panels.description: File descriptors that each Supervisor has open, its network connections included.

panels.title: Network
panels.description: Bytes per second that each Supervisor received and sent over the network.

title: Aviary
